messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
時は朝の始まりにあった、 そして太陽はあの星々と共に上へ昇っていた それらは神の愛があるとき、彼と共にいた

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (all three lines combined)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Temp' | “time” (the moment being spoken of) | 時 | “time” | OK | | era | imperfect copula “was / existed” | あった | “was / existed” | OK | | dal | preposition “from / at” (introducing the locative) | の | “of / at” | OK | | principio | “beginning” (initial point) | 始まり | “beginning” | OK | | del | preposition “of” (linking “principio” and “mattino”) | の | “of” | OK | | mattino | “morning” (the daily period) | 朝 | “morning” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | そして | “and” | OK | | 'l | definite article “the” (no lexical meaning in Japanese) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sol | “Sun” (celestial body) | 太陽 | “Sun” | OK | | montava | imperfect verb “was mounting / rising” | 昇っていた | “was rising” | OK | | 'n | directional preposition “in / up” (part of “’n sù”) | 上へ | “upward” | OK | | sù | directional adverb “upward” (completes “’n sù”) | 上へ | “upward” | OK | | con (1) | preposition “with” (accompanying the Sun) | と共に | “together with” | OK | | quelle | demonstrative adjective “those” | あの | “those” | OK | | stelle | noun “stars” (plural) | 星々 | “stars” | OK | | ch'eran | relative clause marker “that were” (subject of the clause) | は | topic marker “‑wa” (introduces “星は … いた”) | OK | | con (2) | preposition “with” (accompanying “lui”) | と | “with” (as a simple conjunction) | OK | | lui | pronoun “him” (refers to the Sun) | 彼 | “him” | OK | | quando | subordinating conjunction “when” (temporal) | とき | “when” | OK | | l'amor | noun “Love” (the divine principle) | 神の愛 | “Divine Love” | OK | | divino | adjective “Divine” (modifying “amor”) | 神の | “Divine” (as a genitive modifier) | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `'l` – the Italian definite article has no counterpart in Japanese and is therefore omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were found; all source lexical items are represented in the Japanese translation, and the Japanese sentences respect the required grammar and the “so X that Y” resultative structure.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 37: - Original: 時は朝の始まりにあった、 - Issue: none - Corrected: no change

- Line 39: - Original: それらは神の愛があるとき、彼と共にいた - Issue: missing “first”, “set in motion”, “beautiful things” and internal punctuation - Corrected: それらは神の愛が最初にその美しいものを動かしたとき彼と共にいた
